name: Craft starter
description: A blank Hangar starter with a clean folder structure, one frontend page, and one backend health route.
instructions: For the Craft starter, keep it intentionally minimal. Use frontend/src/App.svelte only as a shell, place the initial screen in pages/HomePage.svelte, keep reusable UI in components/, and keep shared helpers in lib/. On the backend, compose routers in backend/main.py, keep endpoints in routers/, add schemas.py, and leave services/ ready for future business logic. Do not seed business data, demo workflows, analytics cards, or CRUD entities.
